name: Undermind
description:
Undermind is your AI co-researcher for the scientific literature. Ask a research question and Undermind searches the literature for you. It follows citation trails, evaluates hundreds of papers, and comes back with a ranked reading list rather than a page of keyword matches.

With Undermind you can: 
Run deep literature searches. Undermind's search agents explore a research question for a few minutes, then report back with a summary and a ranked list of relevant papers.
Look up papers by topic, author, title, DOI, or citation relationships (papers citing or cited by a paper you know), with abstracts and citation metrics.
Ask questions about a paper's full text, including its figures, tables, and equations, and check the answers against the source.
Keep your work organized in workspaces with folders, starred papers, saved searches, and notes, all synced with your account at undermind.ai.

Scientists at thousands of research institutions use Undermind, from university labs to pharma R&D teams. Use it to check whether an idea is new, get oriented in an unfamiliar field, or track down the one method paper you need.

You'll need an Undermind account (free or paid) and to sign in when connecting.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Undermind to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Undermind to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.undermind.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Undermind MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Undermind lists 24 MCP tools, including add_papers_to_folder, create_folder, create_workspace, delete_deep_search, delete_file, delete_folder, find_papers_by_author, get_orientation, get_paper_info, inspect_deep_searches, inspect_files, and inspect_folders.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Undermind?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Undermind in health-life-sciences on the Manufact MCP catalog include Groupon, SNOMED CT Terminology, Rhizome AI - FDA & HA Regulatory Research, Aiva, and Amass Connector.
Undermind requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Undermind is developed by Undermind. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
